caption:
Ever feel like your duas go unanswered?

In old age, with feeble bones and gray hair, Zakariya called on his Lord in private and said he had never been disappointed in his prayer to Him. Keep asking, quietly and often.

Surah Maryam 19:2-4

Make one private dua tonight that no one else knows about

#duaofzakariya #keepmakingdua #surahmaryam #quranreels

Recitation: Yasser Al-Dosari
alt_text: This is a reminder of the mercy of your Lord to His slave Zachariah. When he called upon his Lord in private. He said, “My Lord, my bones have grown feeble, and gray hair has spread across my head, yet never have I been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord (Surah Maryam 19:2-4)
theme: persistence in dua / Zakariya never disappointed
